items.title: ggml/llama.cpp releases: b11513
items.description:
<details open>

CUDA: improve top-k algorithm selection (#28713)

* CUDA: radix top-k for large row counts

Replaces CUB's per-row DeviceTopKKernel with a grid-over-rows radix select,
gated on GGML_CUDA_TOPK_RADIX_MIN_ROWS. On qwen4exp at 34,816 tokens this cuts
top-k from 1,671,253 launches / 5,761
items.summary: The ggml/llama.cpp project improved the top-k algorithm selection for CUDA, implementing a grid-over-rows radix select method that significantly reduces kernel launches for large row counts, enhancing performance in models like qwen4exp. This update is crucial for optimizing computational efficiency in large language models.
items.summary_detailed: The ggml/llama.cpp project updated its CUDA implementation by introducing a radix top-k algorithm for large row counts. This change replaces the previous per-row DeviceTopKKernel with a grid-over-rows approach, which is conditionally enabled based on the GGML_CUDA_TOPK_RADIX_MIN_ROWS parameter. The update significantly reduces the number of kernel launches required for processing qwen4exp at 34,816 tokens, cutting the top-k operations from 1,671,253 to a more efficient count.
items.summary_bullets:
• CUDA: radix top-k for large row counts
• Replaces CUB's per-row DeviceTopKKernel with a grid-over-rows radix select
• Gates on GGML_CUDA_TOPK_RADIX_MIN_ROWS

items.description:
